title: Atelier provides £19.9m for Devon coastal housing scheme
summary:
Development finance lender Atelier has provided a £19.9m peak debt facility for the construction of 57 homes near Westward Ho! on Devon's north coast. The 36-month financing arrangement will support the delivery of 48 private sale homes and nine affordable units.

title: Landlord completes £550,000 London auction purchase in three days
summary:
A landlord has completed the purchase of a three-bedroom terraced property in south-west London for £550,000 using a bridging loan that was processed in three days. Precise provided a 75% loan-to-value facility to meet the auction house's 28-day completion deadline.

title: UK housing market stabilises as rent expectations surge
summary:
The UK housing market showed signs of stabilisation in August with buyer demand and agreed sales improving from recent lows, though both measures remained in negative territory. However, expectations for rent increases strengthened sharply, with respondents predicting rents to rise by around 3% over the next 12 months.

title: TPFG rolls out AI technology across 1,900 branch network
summary:
TPFG is deploying AI technology across its 1,900-branch network, with 14 franchisees already adopting the package and 50 more in the pipeline. Trial implementations have generated 25% more valuation appointments compared to traditional methods, whilst the company addresses 4,000 daily unanswered leads across its network.

title: Rightmove research identifies conveyancing as top property delay
summary:
Rightmove research has identified conveyancing delays as the primary cause of property transaction hold-ups, cited by 37% of movers. The portal has launched an education programme encouraging agents to help clarify the home-moving process to buyers and sellers.

title: UK buyer demand rises 5% in post-summer property bounce
summary:
UK property buyer demand increased by 5% in the first week of September as the market recovered from the summer lull, according to data from Rightmove. The post-summer increase in buyer activity exceeded the five-year average for this period, which typically stands at 0.4%.

title: Estate agents report widespread overvaluation practices
summary:
A survey of estate agents has revealed that 95% believe competitors are providing unrealistic property valuations to secure instructions. Two-thirds reported that overvaluing to win instructions has become more common compared with 12 months ago.

title: Rental growth accelerates across England regions
summary:
Rental prices have increased at a faster rate in most regions of England since the Renters' Rights Act was implemented in May. The West Midlands recorded the most significant acceleration, with rental growth rising by 0.8% compared to 0.2% in the previous period.

title: England’s landlord register launches December 2026
summary:
Landlords in England will be required to register with a new national service under the Renters' Rights Act, with the rollout beginning on 15 December 2026 in the West Midlands. All landlords actively letting property must complete registration by 14 November 2027, with fines for non-compliance.
